# Account-removal navigation tests wait beyond message loading for decrypted text

After removing the displayed message's account, the new OpenPGP and S/MIME tasks select a message from a surviving folder and wait for its expected plaintext. select_click_row already waits for document readiness and nonblank content loading to finish; that helper does not check decrypted body text. The later plaintext condition is therefore a separate test observation. These tasks use normal navigation rather than directly calling the cleanup methods. They do not directly check URI-service membership after navigation, and no browser or cryptographic test ran.

Scope: encrypted-message navigation browser tests.
